method: Viewed the actual current PNG with view_image. Compared both panels with the complete submittedPrompt, GEN-053 manifest, patch, earlier source-binding audit, renderer and parent template/CSS. Compared the saved PNG byte-for-byte against the tool-returned file and matched the receipt, sidecar and submission prompt/arguments.
selectedState: Two independent local ready-state specimens in the authenticated owner saved-history compare pane. A uses selected wide side-by-side; B represents 320px forced unified. Example data is source-derived.
fieldActionRoleStateChecks: Both local crops show 差异对比 active before 历史原文, then the separate 逐行/左右对照 control group. The saved parent mounts these in its own diffToolbarHost. The file label 示例笔记 and 1 addition/1 deletion are coherent with the one-file sample patch.

A shows enabled 逐行 and selected 左右对照. The four headings are 旧行/旧内容/新行/新内容, a single spanning hunk, paired old/new line 1, minus-old and plus-new in separate colored cells. Wide requires viewport >=640 and measured renderer >=600.

B shows 逐行 selected, visibly muted disabled 左右对照. Narrow is viewport <640 or measured host <600 when width is positive. The three headings are 旧行/新行/内容, the same hunk spans them, old line 1 and new line 1 occupy their own rows and the complementary number cells are empty. The native history parent hides the narrow hint.

Both have one right-pointing, default-collapsed 原始差异 disclosure under the structured table. Keep native details/summary and the underlying patch on expansion. Loading, unavailable/retry, original-copy, commit/push and restoration controls are excluded from these local ready specimens.

WS-066 only reuses component regions of the loaded diff. Git uses its own commit baseline, fileLabel, truncation, readiness guard and inline layout toolbar. Saved compare/source tabs and teleport positioning are specific to WS-064.

styleFindings.finding: The external specimen borders, large raster typography, discrete layout button outlines, tab label styling and B row stacking express the two local examples. Implement the existing parent tab icons and compact control row, <=360 padding, grouped buttons, file heading/count badge, change-row styling and native raw disclosure with shared flat tokens. Derive spacing and wrapping from real container dimensions.

generationEvidence.modelVerification: Parent model preflight supplies built-in tool contract. Receipt supplies original file path and actual arguments; per-call model identity is unavailable.

limitations: Static local component-design approval for this SHA only. No product, server, tests, API, keyboard/focus, measured CSS, restore operation or runtime data were exercised.
Separate global coverage/style review and implementation gate remain outside scope.
